raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the density values used for the calculation. It incorrectly stated that the bulk packed density of iron nails is ~0.8 g/cm³ (which is close to the density of wood or some plastics, not iron) and that feather keratin is ~1.3 g/cm³ (which is the density of solid keratin, but feathers as a bulk material with air gaps have a much lower density, typically around 0.002–0.05 g/cm³). Because the Planner used the wrong densities, it reversed the expected mass relationship, concluding that feathers are heavier than iron nails when, in reality, for the same volume, iron nails are significantly heavier due to iron's much higher density (~7.87 g/cm³).
